name: mcp.calendar.add
rests_on: agents-calendar CLI create VEVENT; prefer local wall time for dtstart and dtend plus an optional IANA timezone (explicit timezone, else CALDAV_TIMEZONE or timezone in the credentials file, else the calendar's CalDAV calendar-timezone, else the host zone, else UTC); Z and numeric offsets stay absolute instants; all-day is YYYY-MM-DD or all_day=true with an exclusive dtend; a DST gap or ambiguous naive time errors, retry that instant with an explicit offset; exit 0 = created

dtstart.description: Start as local wall time, for example 2026-11-29T16:00:00. Do not convert that wall time to UTC first. Z or a numeric offset (2026-11-29T16:00:00+01:00) is an absolute instant. All-day: YYYY-MM-DD or all_day=true; dtend is exclusive. If the zone reports a gap or an ambiguous time, retry that instant with an explicit offset.

dtend.description: End, same rules as dtstart. For an all-day event, dtend is exclusive: the same date as dtstart is one civil day.

timezone.description: Optional IANA zone for naive wall times, for example Europe/Berlin. When omitted: CALDAV_TIMEZONE or timezone in the credentials file, then the calendar's CalDAV calendar-timezone, then the host zone, then UTC.

all_day.description: When true, store an all-day event (VALUE=DATE). YYYY-MM-DD for dtstart and dtend does the same. dtend is exclusive.

calendar.description: Target calendar collection name (for example Work) or URL (optional)
